role: Settle whether Townfall survey addresses are ELF virtual addresses or file offsets; derive runtime translation from actual segment correspondence

verdict.question: Are survey addresses ELF virtual addresses or file offsets?
verdict.answer: ELF p_vaddr values (elf_image_vaddr). Proven by survey derivation code (elf_load_spans/object_cfg.rs/elf_tick.rs label bytes with p_vaddr; rip4/ip arithmetic) and byte-level re-derivation from the capture (prologues at vaddr+0x4000; 148 lea-rdi sites target 0x93ba110 with the survey's own alloc/free call evidence).
verdict.runtime_translation: runtime = mapped_start(seg) + (vaddr - seg.p_vaddr); single bias B only if probe proves all mapped_start == B + p_vaddr. Proven today: mapped_start(LOAD0)=0x400000 (EXEC span 0x400000-0x787c000 equals rp(memsz)=0x747c000, prot --X). GUObjectArray (LOAD7 BSS, delta 0x27e110) has NO validated runtime base yet.
